ruleDefinitions.name: Cobalt Strike DNS Beaconing
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious DNS queries known from Cobalt Strike beacons Note: Unmapped fields: query

sequences.query: ((query = RGX("^aaa\\\.stage\\\.") OR query = RGX("^post\\\.1")) OR query = RGX(".*\\\.stage\\\.123456\\\..*"))
